name: note_custom_content
description: Reports what each note section holds, offers to add to it, and puts the patient and provider above the note

handlers.description: Answers NOTE__GET_CUSTOM_CONTENT with a summary above the note and a card per section
Serves the note's blocks and adds the command a section's button offers
Authenticates a note's cards onto the channel carrying its counts
Broadcasts the note's section counts whenever its commands change
